headline: Israeli settlement group touring Britain reported to police over threat to university rector
label: NEWS
caption:
An Israeli non profit group promoting illegal settlements in the West Bank has been reported to Scottish police over an alleged threat against Glasgow University rector Dr Ghassan Abu Sittah. 

According to Middle East Eye, Shivat Zion senior official Shraga Evers responded to criticism by making remarks that critics described as incitement and a de@th threat.

Activist group Jewish Anti Zionist Action reported the organisation and Evers to Police Scotland, calling the remarks a racist and violent diatribe.

British officials stated that the UK does not want to see settlement property advertising and will ensure a comprehensive sanctions regime is implemented.

How should authorities handle foreign groups promoting illegal settlements on domestic soil? 👇
